answer: The ferryman keeps a tally of every crossing, and the tally is cut into the post at the landing, where all can see it. Proof of spice merchant scale via saffron weigh ticket cuts the tally: a parcel the merchant seals only after the ticket shows 2 drams of saffron, weighed on his own brass scale. The summit is the first cut, made when the ferry was built; the pearl is the last, made yesterday at dusk. A cheat must cut 29 false tallies and build 29 false ferries, and the relic still carries no man across.
